title: AgentSandboxConfig
description: Agent Sandbox configuration defining an isolated, policy-controlled environment for AI agents

name.description: Unique name for this sandbox (used in container names and network labels)

deploy_version.description: Optional version stamp injected as DEPLOY_VERSION env var in the agent container (e.g. git tag, CI build number)

platform.description: Container runtime to use for the sandbox

subnet.description: Override the auto-derived /24 for the sandbox-internal network. Set only if the derived subnet collides with an existing Docker network on the host. CIDR form, e.g. 172.31.9.0/24.

secrets.description: Secret groups mapping logical names to environment variable references. Format: { groupName: { secretName: '${ENV_VAR}' } }

services.description: Service definitions for the sandbox containers

agent.description: Agent container configuration: the isolated environment where your AI agent runs

image.description: Base Docker image for the agent container (e.g. 'ubuntu:24.04', 'node:20')

command.description: Override the container entrypoint command (e.g. ['sleep', 'infinity']). Mutually exclusive with command_script.

command_script.description: Path (relative to the config directory) to a user-authored shell script that becomes the agent process. The generator-owned entrypoint runs its security prologue (CA-trust, transparent-egress route) then execs this script as the non-root agent user, so it may use full shell control flow (loops, functions, heredocs). The script must start with a '#!' shebang. Mutually exclusive with command.

workdir.description: Working directory inside the container. Use absolute paths or ~/... for paths relative to user home.

env.description: Environment variables set in the agent container. Can reference secrets via ${SECRET_NAME} syntax.

build_steps.description: Dockerfile RUN commands executed as the non-root user during image build (e.g. 'npm install -g typescript')

user.description: Non-root user configuration. The agent always runs as this user for security isolation.

name.description: Username for the non-root user inside the agent container (created via useradd)

elevated_commands.description: Commands the user can run via sudo without password (NOPASSWD allowlist). Use 'ALL' with caution.

shell.description: Login shell for the non-root agent user (default: bash). 'zsh'/'fish' are installed by the shell plugin (apt) and set via chsh; 'bash' ships in the base image.

gateway.description: Gateway service configuration: the MITM proxy controlling all agent network traffic

egress.description: Outbound traffic rules. Requests not matching any rule are blocked (deny-by-default).

items.description: Egress rule controlling outbound HTTP/HTTPS traffic from the agent

headers.description: Headers to inject into matching requests (e.g. Authorization). Values can reference secrets via ${ENV_NAME} syntax.

denied.description: When true, blocks requests to these hosts instead of allowing them

deny_paths.description: URL path patterns to block on otherwise-allowed hosts (e.g. '/admin/*')

deny_graphql.description: GraphQL-specific restrictions enforced by the github-pat middleware

github_pat_token.description: Environment variable name (${ENV_NAME} format) containing the GitHub PAT for this rule. The gateway resolves it at runtime.

middlewares.description: Middleware chain to apply to matching requests (e.g. 'github-pat')

via.description: Route traffic through a connector (VPN, proxy) contributed by a plugin

plugin.description: Plugin ID providing the connector (e.g. 'builtin://vpn' or bare 'vpn')

profile.description: Profile name within the plugin to use for routing

tcp.description: TCP port forwarding rules for inbound connections

items.description: TCP port forwarding rule for inbound traffic to the sandbox

port.description: Port number exposed on the gateway for inbound connections

target.description: Target address inside the sandbox (e.g. 'agent:8080' forwards to agent container port 8080)

plugins.description: Plugins extending sandbox capabilities (base, SSH, VPN, etc.)

items.description: Plugin reference with typed options per plugin

plugin.description: Policy-enforced Docker access for the agent via a docker-proxy sidecar (DooD)

allowed_images.description: Glob patterns for Docker images the agent may run, e.g. 'node:20-*', 'postgres:16-*'. A lone '*' allows ANY image (only the image gate is lifted — all other controls hold). Required; anything unmatched is denied 403.

allow_build.description: Allow docker build via buildkit sidecar (default: false)

localhost_port_forward.description: Reserved: auto-forward container ports to agent localhost. NOT YET WIRED under the v2 build-step policy (accepted but a no-op); spawned containers remain reachable by name on sandbox-internal (default: false)

allowed_capabilities.description: Linux capabilities to allow on spawned containers, e.g. 'NET_ADMIN' (default: none — all cap_add blocked)

options.title: agent-docker options
options.description: Configuration options for agent-docker plugin. Required: allowed_images. Optional: max_containers, memory, cpus, pids, allow_compose, allow_build, localhost_port_forward, allowed_capabilities.

plugin.description: Gateway egress rules and header/credential injection

api_key.description: Env-NAME ref for the gateway LLM API key, e.g. '${AGW_LLM_GATEWAY_API_KEY}'. Must be a ${NAME} ref (never a literal key); the gateway resolves it from its own .env at forward time.

vpn.description: Optional: route gateway egress through a connector plugin (e.g. `builtin://vpn`). Must be set together with `profile`.

profile.description: Optional: the profile/connector name within `vpn` to route through (e.g. a vpn profile name). Must be set together with `vpn`.

options.title: agw options
options.description: Configuration options for agw plugin. Required: api_key. Optional: vpn, profile.

plugin.description: GitHub PAT auth via the builtin://github-pat gateway middleware, with path and GraphQL-mutation denial

github_pat_token.description: Environment variable reference to the PAT, e.g. '${GITHUB_PAT}' (required)

github_packages.description: Also allow egress to the GitHub Packages registry (npm.pkg.github.com) with a Bearer PAT header. Default false.

deny_paths.description: GitHub REST requests to block, each 'METHOD /path' where '*' matches exactly one path segment (e.g. 'DELETE /repos/*/*'). Matched against api.github.com bare paths by the builtin://github-pat middleware.

deny_graphql.description: GraphQL mutation denylist enforced on POST /graphql (word-boundary match on the request body / X-Github-Graphql-Operation header).

options.title: github-pat options
options.description: Configuration options for github-pat plugin. Required: github_pat_token. Optional: github_packages, deny_paths, deny_graphql.

plugin.description: OAuth bearer-token egress injection for configured API providers via the gateway oauth2-refresh-token credential injector (background token refresh, fail-closed)

providers.description: Map of provider name -> provider config (the name is the injector purpose). Login-only providers need just server_url (endpoints + client are resolved via discovery); egress-injector providers also set host, token_url and the ${ENV} client/refresh refs.

client_id.description: OAuth client id (env-name ref '${NAME}' or literal id)

skip_resource.description: Suppress the RFC-8707 resource param even when server_url is set

callback_url.description: Override the derived OAuth callback URL for this provider

revocation_endpoint.description: RFC 7009 token revocation endpoint (https, same-origin as server_url)

discovery_allowlist.description: Extra SSRF-allowlisted origins the discovery/DCR gate may POST to (e.g. ['https://dcr.notion.com']); default is same-origin as server_url only

host.description: Exact egress host the injected bearer binds to (e.g. 'api.stripe.com')

token_url.description: Token endpoint used by the background refresh (injector path)

refresh_token.description: Refresh-token env-name ref seed for the background injector

callback_url.description: Global OAuth callback URL used when a provider sets none

options.title: oauth options
options.description: Configuration options for oauth plugin. Required: providers. Optional: callback_url.

plugin.description: Seed a folder into a persistent named home volume, resetting managed subtrees on each start

source.description: Project-relative folder to seed into the agent home (e.g. './home-seed' or 'agent-home/')

exclude.description: Glob patterns to exclude from the seed (e.g. '*.log', 'node_modules/')

mirrorPaths.description: Home-relative subtrees made to EXACTLY match the seed on every start (overwrite + delete home-only drift), e.g. '.claude/skills'

options.title: home-volume options
options.description: Configuration options for home-volume plugin. Required: source. Optional: exclude, mirrorPaths.

plugin.description: SSH server inside the agent container for remote dev access (key-only, no tunneling)

authorized_keys.description: Client SSH public keys allowed to connect (e.g. 'ssh-ed25519 AAAA... user@host')

options.title: ssh options
options.description: Configuration options for ssh plugin. Required: authorized_keys. Optional: port.

plugin.description: VPN connector sidecars (tailscale or openvpn) configured via profiles

profiles.description: VPN connector profiles. Each needs: name, type (tailscale|openvpn), and type-specific fields. Tailscale: ts_auth_key (e.g. '${TS_AUTH_KEY}'). OpenVPN: config_b64, username, password.

options.title: vpn options
options.description: Configuration options for vpn plugin. Optional: profiles.

plugin.description: Access containers on external Docker networks by name (e.g. reach a database container)

profiles.description: Bridge profiles to reach containers on external Docker networks. Each needs: name, target (container name), network (Docker network to join).

options.title: host-docker-network-bridge options
options.description: Configuration options for host-docker-network-bridge plugin. Optional: profiles.

plugin.description: Archive selected agent-home paths to a host directory before compose down and restore the latest archive after compose up (Tier-3 host-lifecycle, builtin-only)

options.title: sync-back options
options.description: Configuration options for sync-back plugin. Required: paths, local_directory.

options.title: base options
options.description: No options required for base plugin.

scripts.description: Named scripts for `agent-sandbox run <name>`. Each script is an array of steps. Steps can be 'generate' or 'platform <args>' (runs docker/podman). Use {{path.to.config}} for config values, and {{args}} to forward trailing CLI args (e.g. `agent-sandbox run exec ps aux`).
